import json
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
import os

# Suppress progress bars
os.environ["KMP_DUPLICATE_LIB_OK"] = "TRUE"

# Load data
print("Loading train data...")
train_data = []
with open("./input/train.json", "r") as f:
    train_data = json.load(f)

train_df = pd.DataFrame(train_data)

print("Loading test data...")
test_data = []
with open("./input/test.json", "r") as f:
    test_data = json.load(f)

test_df = pd.DataFrame(test_data)

# Create hold-out validation set
val_split_ratio = 0.2
val_test_ids = (
    train_df["request_id"].sample(frac=val_split_ratio, random_state=42).tolist()
)
train_ids = train_df["request_id"][~train_df["request_id"].isin(val_test_ids)].tolist()

print(f"Training set size: {len(train_ids)}")
print(f"Validation set size: {len(val_test_ids)}")

# Prepare features
train_featured = train_df[train_df["request_id"].isin(train_ids)].copy()
val_featured = train_df[train_df["request_id"].isin(val_test_ids)].copy()
test_featured = test_df.copy()


# Improved temporal feature extraction using ONLY UTC timestamp
def extract_temporal_features_utc_only(df):
    df = df.copy()
    utc_col = "unix_timestamp_of_request_utc"
    if utc_col in df.columns:
        df[f"{utc_col}_day_of_week"] = pd.to_datetime(
            df[utc_col], unit="s"
        ).dt.dayofweek
        df[f"{utc_col}_month"] = pd.to_datetime(df[utc_col], unit="s").dt.month
        df[f"{utc_col}_hour"] = pd.to_datetime(df[utc_col], unit="s").dt.hour
        df[f"{utc_col}_day_of_month"] = pd.to_datetime(df[utc_col], unit="s").dt.day
    return df


train_featured = extract_temporal_features_utc_only(train_featured)
val_featured = extract_temporal_features_utc_only(val_featured)
test_featured = extract_temporal_features_utc_only(test_featured)


# Add character count and word count features
def add_text_length_features(df):
    df = df.copy()
    for col in ["request_text_edit_aware", "request_title"]:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[f"{col}_char_count"] = df[col].apply(
                lambda x: len(str(x)) if pd.notna(x) else 0
            )
            df[f"{col}_word_count"] = df[col].apply(
                lambda x: len(str(x).split()) if pd.notna(x) else 0
            )
    return df


train_featured = add_text_length_features(train_featured)
val_featured = add_text_length_features(val_featured)
test_featured = add_text_length_features(test_featured)


# Explicitly handle giver_username_if_known
def get_giver_username_features(df):
    df = df.copy()
    col = "giver_username_if_known"
    if col in df.columns:
        df[f"{col}_is_known"] = df[col].apply(lambda x: 1 if str(x) != "N/A" else 0)
        df[f"{col}_len"] = df[col].apply(lambda x: len(str(x)) if pd.notna(x) else 0)
        df = df.drop(columns=[col])
    return df


train_featured = get_giver_username_features(train_featured)
val_featured = get_giver_username_features(val_featured)
test_featured = get_giver_username_features(test_featured)

# FIXED: Add interaction features using ONLY requester-level metrics (no post-level)
print("Creating requester-only interaction features...")


def add_interaction_features(df):
    df = df.copy()

    # Requester activity metrics only (available in train, val, and test)
    requester_cols = [
        "requester_account_age_in_days_at_request",
        "requester_days_since_first_post_on_raop_at_request",
        "requester_number_of_comments_at_request",
        "requester_number_of_comments_in_raop_at_request",
        "requester_number_of_posts_at_request",
        "requester_number_of_posts_on_raop_at_request",
        "requester_number_of_subreddits_at_request",
        "requester_upvotes_minus_downvotes_at_request",
        "requester_upvotes_plus_downvotes_at_request",
    ]

    # FIXED: Empty post_cols to ensure validation/test consistency
    post_cols = []  # No post-level engagement metrics to avoid train/val/test mismatch

    # Create interactions only when both columns exist (now only requester metrics)
    for r_col in requester_cols:
        if r_col in df.columns:
            for p_col in post_cols:
                if p_col in df.columns:
                    # Avoid division by zero
                    name = f"{r_col}_vs_{p_col}_ratio"
                    df[name] = np.where(df[r_col] != 0, df[p_col] / df[r_col], 0.0)
    return df


train_featured = add_interaction_features(train_featured)
val_featured = add_interaction_features(val_featured)
test_featured = add_interaction_features(test_featured)

# Identify numeric columns for tabular features
excluded_cols = [
    "request_id",
    "requester_received_pizza",
    "request_text",
    "request_text_edit_aware",
    "request_title",
    "requester_subreddits_at_request",
    "request_text_char_count",
    "request_text_word_count",
    "request_title_char_count",
    "request_title_word_count",
]

numeric_cols = [col for col in train_featured.columns if col not in excluded_cols]

print(f"Tabular features selected: {len(numeric_cols)}")

# Ensure all tabular columns exist in test
test_cols = set(test_featured.columns)
tabular_cols = [col for col in numeric_cols if col in test_cols]

print(f"Tabular columns in test: {len(tabular_cols)}")

# Prepare tabular features
X_train_tab = train_featured[tabular_cols].copy()
X_val_tab = val_featured[tabular_cols].copy()
X_test_tab = test_featured[tabular_cols].copy()

# Convert numeric columns
for col in tabular_cols:
    if X_train_tab[col].dtype == "object":
        try:
            X_train_tab[col] = pd.to_numeric(X_train_tab[col], errors="coerce")
            X_val_tab[col] = pd.to_numeric(X_val_tab[col], errors="coerce")
            X_test_tab[col] = pd.to_numeric(X_test_tab[col], errors="coerce")
        except:
            print(f"Warning: Column {col} could not be converted to numeric")
            tabular_cols.remove(col)
            X_train_tab = X_train_tab.drop(columns=[col])
            X_val_tab = X_val_tab.drop(columns=[col])
            X_test_tab = X_test_tab.drop(columns=[col])
            break

# Fill any NaN values
for col in tabular_cols:
    X_train_tab[col] = X_train_tab[col].fillna(0)
    X_val_tab[col] = X_val_tab[col].fillna(0)
    X_test_tab[col] = X_test_tab[col].fillna(0)

# Handle list columns (like subreddits)
for col in tabular_cols:
    if X_train_tab[col].dtype == "object":
        try:
            X_train_tab[col] = X_train_tab[col].apply(
                lambda x: len(x) if isinstance(x, list) else 0
            )
            X_val_tab[col] = X_val_tab[col].apply(
                lambda x: len(x) if isinstance(x, list) else 0
            )
            X_test_tab[col] = X_test_tab[col].apply(
                lambda x: len(x) if isinstance(x, list) else 0
            )
            X_train_tab[col] = X_train_tab[col].fillna(0)
            X_val_tab[col] = X_val_tab[col].fillna(0)
            X_test_tab[col] = X_test_tab[col].fillna(0)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Warning: Could not handle list column {col}")

# Convert to numpy arrays
X_train_tab = X_train_tab.values.astype(np.float32)
X_val_tab = X_val_tab.values.astype(np.float32)
X_test_tab = X_test_tab.values.astype(np.float32)

# Text features using TF-IDF with increased complexity
print("Extracting TF-IDF features...")
tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=1500, stop_words="english", ngram_range=(1, 2), min_df=1, max_df=0.95
)
tfidf.fit(train_featured["request_text_edit_aware"])

train_tfidf = tfidf.transform(train_featured["request_text_edit_aware"]).toarray()
val_tfidf = tfidf.transform(val_featured["request_text_edit_aware"]).toarray()
test_tfidf = tfidf.transform(test_featured["request_text_edit_aware"]).toarray()

# Concatenate tabular and text features
X_train = np.hstack([X_train_tab, train_tfidf])
X_val = np.hstack([X_val_tab, val_tfidf])
X_test = np.hstack([X_test_tab, test_tfidf])

y_train = train_featured["requester_received_pizza"].values
y_val = val_featured["requester_received_pizza"].values
request_ids_train = train_featured["request_id"].values
request_ids_val = val_featured["request_id"].values
request_ids_test = test_featured["request_id"].values

print(f"X_train shape: {X_train.shape}")
print(f"X_val shape: {X_val.shape}")
print(f"X_test shape: {X_test.shape}")

# Train LightGBM model with adjusted hyperparameters
print("Training LightGBM model...")
lgb_train = lgb.Dataset(X_train, label=y_train)
lgb_val = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=lgb_train)

params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
    "min_data_in_leaf": 20,
    "max_depth": 10,
    "scale_pos_weight": 1.0,
}

model = lgb.train(
    params,
    lgb_train,
    num_boost_round=600,
    valid_sets=[lgb_val],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=30), lgb.log_evaluation(100)],
)

# Compute AUC-ROC on validation set
val_predictions = model.predict(X_val)
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_predictions)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Predict on test set
test_predictions = model.predict(X_test)

# Create submission file matching sample format
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {"request_id": request_ids_test, "requester_received_pizza": test_predictions}
)

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission_df.shape}")
print(f"Validation AUC: {val_auc:.6f}")
